It turns tasks from Linear, GitHub, Jira, Asana, GitLab, or a Host-local task store into isolated"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" Harness Agent runs while preserving the native Harness shell, sidebar, sessions, tools, model selec"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"tion, and permission system."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Loads a `WORKFLOW.md` with YAML frontmatter and a Liquid prompt. Invalid hot reloads are rejected "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"while the last valid definition remains active.
- Supports Linear, GitHub Issues, Jira Cloud, Asana "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"projects, GitLab project issues, and credential-free local tasks.
- Applies deterministic priority o"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"rdering, required labels, global concurrency, and per-state concurrency limits.
- Creates one persis"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"tent workspace per task and runs configurable `after_create`, `before_run`, `after_run`, and `before"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"_remove` lifecycle hooks.
- Runs through native Harness Agents and continues the same Harness sessio"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"n up to the configured turn limit.
- Retries failed runs with bounded exponential backoff and rechec"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ks source state before every dispatch.
- Adds a **Dashboard** entry to the native Harness sidebar. B"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"oard, Runtime, Projects, and Configuration expose task state, session, workspace, turns, tokens, Age"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"nt events, retries, blockers, registered projects, and credential health.
- Maintains a durable Proj"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ect Catalog in Harness storage. Projects can be registered explicitly or discovered within bounded r"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"oots; scanned candidates are never registered without confirmation.
- Models a Project separately fr"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"om its Git Repository. Git projects use a worktree workspace strategy, while non-Git projects use co"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ntrolled directories; autonomous task claims remain off.
- Shows Linear-style `+` controls for the *"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"*Local** source, with create, edit, state, priority, description, and delete operations backed by an"},{"id":"p6s16","text":" atomic Host-side JSON store.
- Keeps external credentials on the trusted Host; credential values ne"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"ver enter Dashboard RPC payloads or browser state."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The `Provider · Project` control beside the Dashboard title is dynamic. Examples include `Linear · E"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"NG`, `GitHub · openai/example`, and `Local · Personal`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Provider support"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Provider | Task identity | Dashboard state source | Host credentials | Agent tool |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Linear | Project issues | Native Linear workflow state | API key | `linear_graphql` |
| GitHub | R"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"epository issues; pull requests are excluded | Configured state labels; open/closed fallback | Fine-"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"grained or classic token | `github_api` |
| Jira Cloud | Project issues selected with enhanced JQL |"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" Native Jira status | Account email + API token | `jira_api` |
| Asana | Tasks in one project | Proj"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ect section; completed tasks use a terminal state | Personal access token | `asana_api` |
| GitLab |"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" Issues in one project | Configured state labels; opened/closed fallback | Personal/project access t"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"oken | `gitlab_api` |
| Local | Tasks in one named local project | States declared in `WORKFLOW.md` "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"| None | `local_task` |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Only one task source is active for a `WORKFLOW.md`. Switching `tracker.kind` changes the board conte"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"xt and scheduler source after the validated workflow reload succeeds."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The Host plugin owns provider access, scheduling, workspaces, hooks, Agent sessions, Project Catalog"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" persistence, local-task persistence, and runtime state. The browser receives a constrained state pr"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ojection and exposes only pause/resume, stop, refresh, Catalog operations, and Local task mutations."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Node.js `22.19+` or `24+`
- pnpm `11.19+` for source builds
- DeepSeek Harness Web profile `0.1.0-"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"rc.6`
- An existing Harness permission preset; the bundled row uses `workspace-write`
- Credentials "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"for the selected remote provider, or no credentials for Local tasks"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"This repository compiles and tests against the published Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` packages. | `currentProject.policyPath` | Project `WORKFLOW.md`, resolved from `currentProje"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ct.root`. |
| `currentProject.registerInCatalog` | Registers the selected workspace in the Project C"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"atalog at startup. |
